data.summary: The available data is insufficient to confirm authenticity, but the signals are highly concerning. A perfect 5.0 score with dozens of reviews and zero complaints across platforms is extremely rare and suggests potential review manipulation or a lack of genuine customer feedback. The absence of any review text for analysis prevents a deeper content-based assessment.
fake_signals: Perfect 5.0 rating with 43 reviews is statistically improbable
No negative or even neutral reviews found
Lack of detailed review content provided for analysis
Company appears in Yelp search results but has no visible rating or reviews on its profile
Very young company (founded 2022) with a flawless record
authentic_signals: Company appears in local search results
data.discrepancy_explanation: A perfect 5.0 rating on Google with 43 reviews is highly unusual for any contractor, especially one with only 3 years in business. This contrasts with the lack of any substantive reviews on Yelp, Angi, Houzz, or Trustpilot. The BBB A+ rating is based on accreditation and complaint handling, not customer reviews, which are absent. The perfect score with no negative feedback is a major red flag.
